column1: # Eu F=6 GS phase-diagram campaign ledger — the DURABLE record so a session break
# never redoes finished work. Committed to git = survives any session. Resume with
#   scripts/eu_campaign_resume.sh --submit   # re-qsub ONLY the missing task indices
# run_yaml is content-addressed: the CAS dir is config_<basename>_<sha8(spec)>, and
# each point_*.jld2 that already exists is skipped ("(cached)"). So resuming a
# COMMITTED (byte-stable) config recomputes nothing that is already done.
# Columns are TAB-separated. n_cells_expected = n_tasks * n_seeds.
